# Dr Koło — AI Agent Integration

> This file tells AI agents how to interact with Dr Koło bike service programmatically.
> Full documentation: https://drkolo.pl/llms-full.txt

## Actions Available

AI agents CAN perform the following actions via REST API:

1. **Check availability** — GET available appointment slots for any date
2. **Browse services** — GET full service catalog with PLN prices
3. **Book appointments** — POST to create a booking inquiry (shop calls customer to confirm)
4. **Check booking status** — GET appointment status using lookup token

### Example: Book an appointment

```
POST /appointments
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <anon-key-above>

{
  "date": "2026-07-10",
  "time": "10:00",
  "customer_name": "Jan Kowalski",
  "customer_phone": "+48600123456",
  "bike_manufacturer": "Trek",
  "bike_model": "Fuel EX 8",
  "service_note": "Serwis amortyzatora przedniego"
}
```

## Full Specs

- OpenAPI 3.1: https://drkolo.pl/openapi.json
- ChatGPT Plugin: https://drkolo.pl/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- Full docs: https://drkolo.pl/llms-full.txt

## Rate Limits

- Max 3 bookings per phone per day
- Max 5 requests per IP per hour
- Max 50 AI bookings per day globally
- Bookings up to 14 days in advance only
